defect: Extreme options are stored as text ('1 = أرفض بشدة', '5 = أتفق بشدة') while middle options are stored as bare numbers; naive numeric coercion silently drops 1,516 of 2,201 Likert cells (69%) and, because only the extremes are lost, shifts item means by up to +0.48 points
recommended_fix: Label all five points identically so every cell exports as text, then recode by explicit lookup; ship the lookup in the codebook

defect: Two-item subscale (inter-item r = .50; alpha = .60 Arabic / .67 pooled), below the conventional .70 floor
recommended_fix: Expand to 4-5 concern items (academic integrity, data privacy, misattribution, over-reliance, assessment fairness)

defect: Two constructs used as predictors are measured by one item each, so no reliability can be estimated and measurement error is unmodelled
recommended_fix: Add 2-3 parallel items per construct, or state explicitly that they are single-indicator

defect: Tools, purposes, assignment types and challenges are check-all items exported as concatenated strings (14-39 distinct combinations); percentages computed from them have no single natural denominator
recommended_fix: Export one binary column per option and report both the per-respondent and per-mention denominator explicitly in every caption

item_text_ar: no reverse-keyed items inside positively worded blocks
defect: Benefit, literary-skill, poetry and rhetoric blocks are uniformly positively keyed, leaving agreement bias uncontrolled
recommended_fix: Reverse-key roughly one third of the items in each block and recode before scoring

item_text_ar: no attention or care check; no 'not applicable' option
defect: Nothing detects inattentive straightlining, and respondents with no experience of a task must still answer, pushing them to the midpoint
recommended_fix: Add one instructed-response check and an explicit 'not applicable / never tried this' option scored as missing

defect: Only gender and year of study (3 levels) are collected: no age, no prior AI-training item, no discipline track. The submitted manuscript reports '20% with prior AI training', which no item in this instrument measures
recommended_fix: Add age, prior AI training (yes/no plus type), and track; drop any manuscript claim that no item supports

defect: 78% choose أوافق or أوافق بشدة and the lowest option is never used, so the item cannot discriminate
recommended_fix: Reword to a graded frequency stem or split into two more specific statements

defect: Only three open prompts, each answered by 61 of 67 respondents, and none asks for a concrete instance of a breakdown (wrong parse, invented verse, fake reference)
recommended_fix: Add prompts that request one specific example with the tool named and, where possible, the output pasted in; this is what converts self-report into auditable evidence
